notes.title: Corebreaker Coming to Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Corebreaker will participate in the Steam Next Fest starting February 24, 2025.

From February 24 to March 3, 2025, a time-limited demo version will be available for free download.

Corebreaker is a fast-paced 2D action-shooting roguelite game. You play as Nova, a robot awakened after humanity's extinction by machines, who must break through heavily guarded underground ruins using agile movements and powerful firearms to reach the core.

▼Demo Contents
[list]
[*] First stage of the main game
[*] Multiple weapons including Shotgun, Machine Gun, Bazooka, Plasma
[*] Various upgrade items and enhancement paths
[/list]

※ The full version will include more enemies, weapons, and upgrades

If you enjoy the demo, please add the game to your wishlist:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2190920/_/

Thank you in advance for your support!

notes.title: Happy Lunar new year from Corebreaker
notes.content:
Fellow mates,

From January 27th to February 10th, [i]Corebreaker[/i] will be part of Steam's Lunar New Year Sale. All of us at aQuadiun extend our heartfelt wishes to our incredible Asian player community.

As we welcome the new year, we’re continuing to actively work on [i]Corebreaker[/i]. Thank you for your support, and don’t forget to add our game to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2190920/_/

[i]Corebreaker[/i] is a fast-paced action-platformer game with rogue-like elements. Play as Nova, a robot designed to awaken when humanity is extinct by the machines. Unlock abilities, upgrades and powerful weapons as you fight your way through supreme robots to find out your purpose!

Wishing you all a Happy New Year in the Year of the Snake!

The [i]Corebreaker[/i] Team
